name: cardgame-card-authoring-engine
title: Deterministic card authoring engine (layout renderer)
pitch: Render every alpha-set.md card into a print-ready SVG straight from structured data plus the anatomy skeleton spec, leaving the art window an empty slot for a later Leonardo compositing pass.
why_now: card-anatomy-skeleton (the layout contract) and alpha-set-starter-cards (the structured card data) both already shipped, so the only missing piece is the renderer that consumes them; T16 named this exact tool today as explicitly allowed under the partial software-gate opening.
expected_outcome: running `node tools/card-authoring/render.js` from the cardGame repo exits 0 and writes one SVG per alpha-set.md card into build/cards/, each showing the correct Fount-colored frame, name, cost symbols, type line and rules text pulled from the source markdown, with the art window left visibly blank
intent: Build a deterministic layout engine for cardGame's Alpha set: given design/cards/alpha-set.md (card data) and design/cards/card-anatomy.md (the shared skeleton spec), render each card as a self-contained SVG with all text/symbol elements (frame color by Fount, name, cost line, type line, rules text, stats) laid out programmatically — never generated by an image model — while the Art Window zone stays an empty placeholder reserved for a future art-compositing step. This is authoring tooling, not gameplay software, per T16's partial gate opening.

criteria.text: tools/card-authoring/render.js exists and `node tools/card-authoring/render.js` exits 0, producing one output file in build/cards/ per card section found in design/cards/alpha-set.md
each rendered card's Name, Cost line, Type line, and Rules text are pulled verbatim from alpha-set.md rather than hardcoded, so editing a card in alpha-set.md changes the render
each card's Frame/Border color follows the Fount-to-color identity stated in card-anatomy.md's "The Variables" section
the Art Window zone renders as an empty/placeholder slot with no generated art, per T16's rule that gen-AI only fills the art-window image later
multi-Fount cards (2+ Founts in their cost) render the multi-Fount band treatment described in card-anatomy.md, not a single solid frame color
